pythonFunction.name: submit_wgl_payment_extension
pythonFunction.description:
Moves the due date to a later date within the allowed maximum; one extension per billing cycle.
Needs an authenticated caller who chose the date. Before calling this tool, speak a brief
conversational pacing phrase while it runs.

Args:
    account_id: Leave empty: the identified account is used automatically (any other id is refused).
    new_due_date: New due date, YYYY-MM-DD (REQUIRED).
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.

Returns:
    dict with ok, confirmation_number and new_due_date. When the account has a shutoff date earlier
    than the new due date, the shutoff date moves to the new due date as well.
